faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Project Scientist position at IIT Delhi is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech degree in Applied Optics, Photonics, or Optoelectronics with a minimum CGPA/CPI of 7.5 to be eligible for the Project Scientist role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive as per the provided information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Scientist position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 66,667 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Delhi Project Scientist job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Scientist position at IIT Delhi through this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist position is a contractual job opportunity at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Scientist position will involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is prior experience required for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: While not strictly mandatory, prior experience in integrated photonics and fiber optics is preferred for the Project Scientist position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is advised to download and read it thoroughly before applying.
